goal: Stop the weekly Mac job losing a week when the Mac is asleep on Sunday morning: on 2026-11-22 launchd ran the missed job in a 2-second dark wake, the first network call failed across the sleep, and nothing ever retried it.
changed: The launch agent starts the job every hour and passes the new --scheduled flag; plain runs, --dry-run and --run-now are unchanged.

--scheduled runs only from Sunday 06:00 to Monday 23:59 in CFO_TZ, skips a dark wake (no Graphics in pmset's capabilities) with one log line, and writes a stamp only after a run exits 0, so a failed run is retried every hour until the window closes and a finished week is left alone.
SKILL.md describes the schedule, the dark-wake skip and the stamp file.

claims.claim: A --scheduled run inside the window with a dark-wake pmset prints one line and exits 0 without a clone, a gh call or a Vercel call; after a failed run (no stamp) the next run books the rows and writes the stamp; the run after that exits 0 silently and clones nothing; outside the window, and for Monday after a Sunday stamp, nothing runs; the window edges are Sunday 06:00 and Monday 23:59; a missing pmset does not block the run; a plain run ignores window, stamp and pmset.
claims.check: tests/test_weekly_claude_code.py through a fake pmset, gh and vercel; the 8 new tests failed at 2d914c6 and pass at f57c3d1, and 5 loops of them were green
claims.remaining: A fake pmset, not a real battery dark wake; launchd was not installed or fired.

claims.claim: --print-plist gives StartCalendarInterval {Minute: 0} and ends ProgramArguments with --scheduled, and --install writes it.
claims.check: plist tests parse the printed and the installed plist
claims.remaining: The user's installed agent still has the old schedule until --install is run again.

next.item: Run weekly-claude-code.sh --install again on the Mac
next.source: inferred: the installed plist is not rewritten by merging
next.why_now: Until then the agent keeps the old Sunday-06:00-only schedule and the week can still be lost.
next.impact: Beau's Mac job survives a sleeping Sunday morning.
